description: What Swell Cabin posts on social media, worked out from its own data, every post with a reviewed photo: a surf spot in its own photos (the backbone, one a day: its best photo with its name, the others bare, then its next good day or its year as twelve dots), a town in its breaks (a carousel, Tuesdays and Fridays), the day's own format (this or that: two towns Great or Epic on the same weekend day, side by side, on Wednesdays and Thursdays; where is this?: a surfing photo with three clues on Sundays; a coast in stops: a region's towns in the order of the road on Tuesdays; what to wear this month, from the water as it is now), the site as it looks (a town's page in a phone on Mondays, a spot's card on Thursdays; an 8-second reel of a town's page scrolling to its week when a Great or Epic day is coming, on Wednesdays and Saturdays), a reviewed local Instagram account's recent surf post, shared and credited, reposts with our take (the best real surf clips in its Feed this week, shared as the creator's own YouTube video, credited, with Swell Cabin's take: the next good day there with how sure the forecast is, the water and wetsuit, the season; picked by its own signals, never by YouTube's view counts), a standout day (the only forecast post of its own: Epic, or Great with high confidence on a day at least 1.5 times the town's usual for the month with a long-period swell or in a month when Great is rare there, one or two days ahead), the weekend's Great and Epic towns, a town's surf season opening, surf events, the evergreen kinds (where to surf this month: the best-known towns in season with the water and wetsuit; a town spotlight in its season; about Swell Cabin, in its own numbers), and the weekly stories (swell on the move: a 14 s swell making good surf in towns of one region; the local surf scene, a town's reviewed local accounts, on Tuesdays; learn to surf this weekend on Thursdays; surf by day, out by night on Fridays; the spot of the week with a reviewed, credited surf clip on Saturdays). The everyday best day, swell alert and week-in-numbers posts are no longer made. Cards are the town's or spot's reviewed, freely licensed photo edge to edge with the name, one line and the credit; a carousel's spots or a list's towns follow as photo slides. With a town: the posts it would make about that town now (reposts come from the whole Feed, so they are only in the daily proposal), best first, each written for Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, Bluesky and Mastodon with its time (UTC, in the town's morning or evening), link, card image (a PNG drawn from the same facts: card for a feed post, story for 9:16) and the facts every number comes from. Without a town: the latest daily proposal across every town (the owner approves it; the approved posts go out through Buffer) and the posts already scheduled. A post names a surf spot only when it is well known (it has a cam or surf clips), and never says today or tomorrow (it goes out later than it's written).
